ruledOut.approach: Interpret agreement as accuracy against ground truth
ruledOut.reason: The inspected report compares Pi to CLI and contains no independent label set.

ruledOut.approach: Treat Pi cost as proven cheaper than CLI
ruledOut.reason: CLI cost is null and cost is absent from the judge gates.

findings.claim: Adopt uses fixed coverage, agreement, and relative-latency gates; cost does not affect verdict.
111/111 Pi rows were measured over 333 calls with zero reported timeouts/exclusions; Pi p95 340 ms, recorded CLI 387 ms.
95.5% agreement is a one-row margin over the 95% threshold; counts are derived from rounded report rate.
Parity is measured across different provider/model versions with a recorded CLI arm; it does not establish ground-truth correctness or isolate transport.
Pi usage cost is reported but CLI cost is null and cost is not a verdict gate.
The packet scope misnames the scorer and says Phase 047, while the executable scorer and recorded/adopted run are under features 037/038.
